Products & Deployments
One foundation model for laser processes. Powering our flagship platform, the world's leading laser systems, and the design tools engineers already use.
Our AI-native build preparation platform for metal LPBF. Printability validation, automated supports, and physics-aware exposure optimization — first-time-right at scale.
Embedded inside EOS industrial systems — turning the world's leading metal AM machines into self-optimizing production platforms.
With SCANLAB, we're driving the next generation of laser control — AI-enhanced scan-head intelligence for unprecedented speed and precision in additive manufacturing.
AI-Defined Production Floor
A vertically integrated production floor run by our foundation models. From design to qualified metal part in days, not months — sovereign European AM at industrial scale.
Not an LLM. Not a digital twin. A physics-based AI trained to predict and govern what happens when laser energy transforms material — and transferable across laser-based manufacturing methods.
Thermal physics · Melt pool prediction · Microstructure
Predictions and corrections at every individual scan point — not just per vector. Power, speed, and timing modulated continuously along the path at the finest resolution the hardware allows.
OEM proprietary file formats · Direct scan system integration
Predict defects before they occur. Our models learn the physics of melt pools, thermal fields, and microstructure evolution to flag failure modes in advance.
Powering production at leading machine builders, laser companies, and manufacturers.
